nodes.name: Slack ticket received
nodes.notes: Attach the Slack credential using SLACK_BOT_TOKEN. Subscribe only to the support-ticket channel; confirm bot-generated simulator messages are delivered.

nodes.name: Normalize and validate input
nodes.notes: Do not embed an empty text. Route empty text directly to ingest_ticket with a null embedding to record rejected_invalid.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ taskType: 'CLUSTERING', output_dimensionality: 768, content: { parts: [{ text: $('Normalize and validate input').item.json.text }] } }) }}

nodes.name: Embed ticket with Gemini
nodes.notes: Attach HTTP Header Auth using GEMINI_API_KEY as x-goog-api-key. Keep the API key in n8n credentials, never in this export.

nodes.name: Assign seed-anchored cluster
nodes.notes: Attach the Postgres credential. This uses the Postgres node's parameter binding rather than interpolating ticket text into SQL.

nodes.name: Run verification and triage sub-workflow
nodes.notes: After importing cluster-review.template.json, select it here by ID in the n8n UI. The current item provides cluster_id to its Execute Sub-workflow Trigger.

nodes.name: Record invalid ticket
nodes.notes: Attach the same Postgres credential. This safe path must never reach Gemini or Slack engineering alerts.
